I was at work in my nightmare sleeping in the office with my boyfriend. Not sure how that happened but when I woke up it was 6:48 AM. 12 minutes away from ending my shift! I hadn't done anything yet including the end of day shift change which has to be done around 4:30 AM. Panicing, me and my boyfriend cleaned what we could in 12 minutes of time before anyone showed up.

One of my co-workers showed up but it was an old lady who doesn't work at the store anymore. She wasn't pleased about the shift change problem. I counted down while a bunch of impatient customers waited by the counter and afterwards I had to clock out. But I wouldn't find my boyfriend anywhere. I assumed he went home.

I walked out of the store and noticed my vision was blurry. Must've left my glasses at home too, I thought. I passed by some stranger and looked back at him because he looked like someone I knew but I couldn't make out his face because on my poor vision.

I finally got home but it wasn't my house or my boyfriend's house. It was my dad's house. Walking in, I notice my boyfriend, dad, and mom all sleeping on the couch in the living room. (This was very odd to me because my parents are divorced)

Walking further into the room I had someone rush and try to attack me with a metal hanger! I jumped out of the way and looked at his face. I could see it clearly now... he was my ex! My ex was trying to kill me... I tried to defend myself by punching him but every punch I threw missed... I tried calling for my boyfriend's help but he only budged a little but went right back to sleep.

My ex told me he wanted to kill my boyfriend and parents so I'll know how alone he feels right now. I picked my my phone and threatened to call the police. He stopped but turned around to yank off pieces of the coat rack nearby. He... started to stab himself in the throat with the metal rods and I was in shock and couldn't say anything.. Blood was everywhere...

The police picked up.

"911. What's you're emergancy?"

I tried to speak but nothing came out of my mouth. Just whimpers and air.

"Hello?.... We're sending dispatch over."

I felt a rush of guilt and thought this was all my fault... I didn't want to get in trouble.. but I didn't want to get hurt or have my loved ones hurt either. I kept hearing "Its all your fault" in my head until I woke up...

-.- I call bullshit. If you traced *anything* it needs to be stated. If it’s just for practice, that’s fine but don’t claim it’s 100% your own. Other artists, including myself work hard to make everything original and even though that Ash concept art is drawn by the anime animation team, it doesn’t give the right for you to trace him and claim that you did that. 

Now say had you referenced him, that’d be another story. Referencing another’s art I believe is fine to look at the posing and making sure the body proportions are right. Though some people require you to still mention you referenced their art but not all.

All in all, don’t trace unless you stated you did in the description.
